Private log As String

Public Sub Auto_Open()
    log = log & "open;"
End Sub

Public Sub Auto_Close()
    log = log & "close;"
End Sub

Public Sub Auto_Activate()
    log = log & "activate;"
End Sub

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String, other As Workbook
    Set other = Workbooks.Add
    On Error Resume Next
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoOpen
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoClose
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoClose
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoActivate
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoActivate
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoDeactivate
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros 0
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoDeactivate
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoOpen
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros "1"
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros Which:=xlAutoClose
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros Which:=xlAutoClose
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    other.RunAutoMacros xlAutoOpen
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoOpen
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros 5
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros -1
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    Application.Run "Auto_Open"
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoOpen
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    log = "": Err.Clear
    ThisWorkbook.RunAutoMacros xlAutoOpen
    s = s & "@@@" & IIf(Err.Number, "Err " & Err.Number, "ok " & log)
    other.Close False
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
